channels.name: SMBCLK
channels.active_levels: pulled up to VDD; driven low by master (clock stretching allowed)

channels.name: SMBDAT
channels.active_levels: pulled up to VDD; driven low for 0

channels.name: SMBALERT#
channels.purpose: Shared interrupt; serviced via the ARA.

channels.name: CONTROL (PMBus)
channels.purpose: Hardware enable for the converter output.

handshake_pairs.name: Address+RW / ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Slave ACKs the 9th clock if its address matches.

handshake_pairs.name: Byte / ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Each byte ACK/NACK'd on the 9th clock; MSB-first.

handshake_pairs.name: PEC / check
handshake_pairs.rule: CRC-8 over the transaction; NACK on mismatch.

handshake_pairs.name: SMBALERT# / Alert Response
handshake_pairs.rule: Device pulls SMBALERT# low; host reads the ARA; lowest address wins.

handshake_pairs.name: ARP Get-UDID / Assign-Address
handshake_pairs.rule: Enumerate by 128-bit UDID, then assign a 7-bit address.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All devices share SMBCLK/SMBDAT (open-drain wired-AND); a transaction is framed by START/STOP; bytes are MSB-first with per-byte ACK. SMBALERT# is an independent wired-OR interrupt. The PMBus command meaning depends on the active PAGE.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A valid transaction requires: (1) bus free (no active transaction), (2) addressed device present (ACK), (3) PEC match if PEC is enabled. PMBus reads/writes depend on the active PAGE; output-enable depends on OPERATION + CONTROL pin + ON_OFF_CONFIG.

fields.ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)

ordering_rules.byte_order: PMBus multi-byte values are little-endian on the bus (low byte first) for Word transactions.
ordering_rules.transaction_atomicity: One transaction at a time on the shared bus; group/zone commands defer action to a common STOP.
